title: College Football
description:
Massachusetts at Rutgers
The UMass Minutemen and the Rutgers Scarlet Knights meet for a Week 1 season opener at SHI Stadium. The Minutemen suffered a 0-12 winless record during their 2025 season and look for redemption. Rutgers lost to Penn State in their final 2025 game.

title: College Football
description:
Alabama-Birmingham at Illinois
The UAB Blazers and the Illinois Fighting Illini battle at Gies Memorial Stadium. The Blazers won against the Golden Hurricanes, 31-24, in their final 2025 game. Illinois defeated Tennessee 30-28 in the Liberty Mutual Music City Bowl in 2025.
